method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Undocumented status translated无证 not lack of any personal identity documents; candidate no-deportation pledge retained.
Path to legal status not necessarily citizenship; do not insert naturalization entitlement.
Odd couple colloquial mismatched pair; possible cultural allusion unconfirmed, not claimed author citation. Original callng/voter blocks typos interpreted calling/blocs.
Small-c conservative cautious/traditional disposition, not formal Conservative Party affiliation.
Original emphasis tag on two preserved exactly.

revisions.source: They're going to wish they had confirmed him, once I am elected President. This choice is overly conciliatory, when we consider it was made in the face of a colossally obstructionist strategy on the part of the Republicans.
revisions.zh: 等我当选总统，他们就会后悔没有确认他了。共和党采取了如此严重的阻挠策略，而这个人选是在这种情况下提出的，实在过于迁就他们。

revisions.source: The Republican obstruction is a clear and obvious attempt to subvert democratic norms. We should all be very concerned about this move, and I will stand by the nomination of Merrick Garland when I am elected.
revisions.zh: 共和党的阻挠，显然是在企图破坏民主惯例。我们都应该高度警惕这种做法。我当选后，会坚持对梅里克·加兰的提名。

revisions.source: The fact of the matter is, we as Democrats don't have the power to stop this. We need to make sure that we can win enough states, red states even, to contest the Senate over the next few years.
revisions.zh: 事实是，作为民主党人，我们没有力量阻止这件事。必须确保我们能赢下足够多的州，甚至包括红州，才能在未来几年争夺参议院控制权。

revisions.source: I will not deport any undocumented immigrant who is working hard and playing by the rules in this country, that is correct.
revisions.zh: 没错，我不会驱逐任何在这个国家努力工作、遵守规则的无证移民。

revisions.source: That's not quite what I said, actually. I was only referring to immigrants who have been in this country for many years and integrated into their communities.
revisions.zh: 其实，我并不是这么说的。我说的只是那些已在美国生活多年、融入所在社区的移民。

revisions.source: Let's talk about Donald Trump's proposals. He would deport millions of undocumented immigrants, tearing holes in their communities and ravaging regional economies. And let's not get started on the Wall...
revisions.zh: 来谈谈唐纳德·特朗普的提议吧。他要驱逐数百万无证移民，撕裂他们的社区，严重破坏地方经济。更别提那堵墙了……

revisions.source: We must acknowledge that illegal immigration is a serious problem. Now unlike Donald Trump, I support dealing with that problem in a humane way, but ultimately we do need reform with tougher enforcement, and a path to legal status for some immigrants.
revisions.zh: 我们必须承认，非法移民是个严重问题。与唐纳德·特朗普不同，我支持用人道的办法解决，但归根结底，我们确实需要改革，加强执法，并为部分移民提供取得合法身份的途径。

revisions.source: Bernie Sanders and I have some differences, but we have far more in common. We cannot allow petty disputes to divide our party in the face of a potential Trump Administration.
revisions.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯和我有一些分歧，但共同点多得多。面对特朗普可能执政的局面，我们不能让琐碎争执分裂本党。

revisions.source: We need to remember how the past several months transpired, and the strength that Bernie enjoys among the grassroots. Simply ignoring him was not an option for our campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们需要记住过去几个月发生了什么，以及伯尼在基层中拥有的力量。我们的竞选团队根本不能选择无视他。

revisions.source: Pundits have taken to callng you two "the odd couple", but Sanders is very popular with a variety of voter blocks.
revisions.zh: 评论人士开始把你们称作“不般配的一对”，但桑德斯在各种选民群体中都很受欢迎。

revisions.source: This is a good response to fire up the base.
revisions.zh: 这是一个能激发基本盘热情的好回答。

revisions.source: Some commentators sense a bit of small-c conservatism in your answer.
revisions.zh: 一些评论人士从你的回答中感到了一点保守、谨慎的倾向。

revisions.source: Pundits on both the left and the right debate your about-face on this issue.
revisions.zh: 左翼与右翼的评论人士，都在讨论你在这个问题上的彻底转向。

revisions.source: Calling illegal immigration a “serious problem” raises some eyebrows on the left. But other people hear you as well.
revisions.zh: 把非法移民称为“严重问题”，让一些左翼人士感到意外。不过，也有其他人听到了你的话。

revisions.source: Do you think America is ready for a ticket with two women on it? And what does Elizabeth Warren bring to the table, electorally?
revisions.zh: 你觉得美国准备好接受两位女性搭档参选了吗？从选举角度看，伊丽莎白·沃伦能带来什么？

revisions.source: Elizabeth Warren is out in front on the issues of debt forgiveness, economic fairness, and in fighting the influence of Wall Street on American policy. She will help us fight the unfair influence of the 1%.
revisions.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在债务减免、经济公平，以及抵制华尔街对美国政策的影响等议题上走在前列。她会帮助我们对抗最富有的1%人群所施加的不公平影响。

revisions.source: Elizabeth Warren has admirably served Massachusetts as a Senator, and she will bring that experience and ability to the national stage as my Vice President.
revisions.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦作为参议员，出色地服务于马萨诸塞州。担任我的副总统后，她会把这些经验和能力带到全国舞台。

revisions.source: There is no one more capable and thoughtful whom we've talked to than Elizabeth Warren. She understands the issues that this country faces, and how to be an effective leader in addressing them.
revisions.zh: 在我们谈过的人选中，没有谁比伊丽莎白·沃伦更有能力、更深思熟虑。她了解这个国家面临的问题，也懂得如何有效地领导大家解决这些问题。

revisions.source: We have seen one Presidential ticket after another with two men on the ticket. Let's give women a fair shake for once! I'm confident our supporters will be motivated and galvanized by the Clinton-Warren ticket.
revisions.zh: 我们已经见过一对又一对男性搭档竞选总统。这回就给女性一个公平的机会吧！我相信，我们的支持者会因为克林顿—沃伦这对组合而受到鼓舞，积极行动。

revisions.source: Elizabeth Warren has been out in front on the issues of student loan debt, consumer finance, and bankruptcy. She is a deeply intelligent woman whom I'm proud to share a ticket with.
revisions.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在学生贷款债务、消费者金融和破产等议题上走在前列。她极其聪慧，我很自豪能与她搭档参选。

revisions.source: Headlines like, "Is America Ready for Two Women?" proliferate, for better or worse.
revisions.zh: 不管是好是坏，“美国准备好接受两位女性了吗？”这类头条越来越多。
